notes: The author self-declares a shooting game and then describes endless hordes to outlast, so Shooter leads and Survival is named second in the author's own words. None of Shooter's competitive presets fits a solo wave holdout, so I took the secondary genre's Horde Defense, whose shape is the one the prompt describes: a small arena closed by an extremely high blue wall, sized so enemies stay inside pistol range. Dropped Horde Defense's destructible-cluster and cover-los because the author specifies a bare white floor with nothing in it, which leaves the enemy wave origin as the only structural pick. With no user to ask, I treated the invincibility, recoil and auto-aim as gameplay rather than layout, and followed the answer that waves never end, so no exit or finish is placed.
